📁 Manual Master Data & Reference Uploads (Excel / PDF)

These 4 reference files (Surveyor/VAO mappings, PDF application status, Firka lists) are manually uploaded reference sheets and are NOT auto-pulled or overwritten by Auto/Flash Fill.

V Village Detailsall taluks · S.No · Taluk · Village · Name (surveyor) not loaded
VA VAO Detailsall taluks · S.No · Taluk · Village · Name (VAO) not loaded
PDF ISD Rural — Application StatusPDF from drilldowntasildar.html (Tahsildar ID 2) not loaded
FK NISD — Village / Firka listS.No · Village Name · Firka (ZDT / HQDT) not loaded

The ISD Rural report is built from the OPT Pending exports (one per day range) plus the Application Status PDF. Village Details supplies surveyor names, VAO Details supplies VAO names. The ISD Natham and F Line Excel files feed the separate combined dashboard further down; dates are read as DD-MM-YYYY and only rows whose Application Status starts with Pending are counted there.

The dashboard updates automatically as you load files.
